_about: Player HUD + game loop look (lane V66HUD), read by GameHUD.cs / GameLoop.cs / HudCfg.cs (StreamingAssets first, then Assets/Data). All sizes are px at referenceHeight (1080) and scale with Screen.height (clamped minScale..maxScale). Colours are [r,g,b(,a)] 0..1. Missing file or enabled=false keeps the built-in defaults. No art assets: bars, lines, edge gradients and ticks are drawn from code.

debug._about: Developer overlays are off in the player. camLine needs this flag true or the -camdebug argument; F3 / -fps show the FPS label.

hint._about: Controls hint: bottom-left, shown showSeconds after the fight starts (after delayS), fades over fadeSeconds, F1 toggles it (pinned on / hidden). Rows are the real keys (PlayerBrain.cs, dodge.json, flow.json).
hint.title: CONTROLS

rows.a: Slide left / right / up = cut direction; none = stab

vignette._about: Damage taken: a red edge pulse. alpha = minAlpha + damageFraction (of max HP) * gain, clamped to maxAlpha, then fades over seconds (unscaled).

lowHp._about: Subtle heartbeat pulse of the same edge below threshold (fraction of max HP). Two soft beats per cycle, faster as HP falls.

hitTick._about: Hit confirm: four short ticks around the foe's chest on a landed blow. Heavy blows and guard breaks are larger and gold, a blocked blow is dim.

victory.title: VICTORY
victory.subtitle: The {0} falls. The gate stands open.

defeat.title: YOU DIED
defeat.subtitle: The dark takes you. Rise again.

input._about: confirm = Next opponent after a victory, Retry after a defeat (only while the end screen shows). retry = Retry; midFightRetry = restart during a fight (Backspace as before; Enter no longer restarts mid-fight). Names are UnityEngine.KeyCode.
